subject.name: Yasmin Korin
subject.summary: High school student and AI research intern working on retrieval-augmented generation, machine-readable knowledge, data provenance, verification, engineering applications of AI, and structured identity systems.

experience.description: Created and deployed a retrieval-augmented generation microservice using Python, FastAPI, ChromaDB, semantic search, parent-child chunking, GitHub, and SHA-256 source verification. Researches AI applications in civil engineering and transportation including data governance, provenance, structured knowledge systems, and VVUQ.

Researched alternative funding models for engineering research teams, conducted outreach to engineering departments and professional organizations, and worked with automated data workflows for research and outreach initiatives.
Tutors K–12 students in mathematics ranging from foundational arithmetic through precalculus and adapts instruction to individual learning styles and academic needs.

projects.name: Machine-Readable Identity / SBT Prototype
projects.description: Designed a machine-readable identity object that represents personal experience, skills, credentials, and projects as structured data and supports provenance, evidence, verification status, and permissions at the claim level.

projects.name: ASCE Member Registry / Verified RAG Target Prototype
projects.description: Designed and built a working prototype for a machine-readable member registry intended to store structured professional information with verification, validation, provenance, and permissions metadata.

projects.name: ASCE AI-Readiness Memo / Public Memo RAG Prototype
projects.description: Structured an AI-readiness memo for retrieval-augmented generation using parent-child chunking, ChromaDB, SHA-256 source verification, and a FastAPI search endpoint while preserving source provenance and traceability.

projects.name: Model Rocket Compliance Checker
projects.description: Structured regulatory requirements for model rocketry into machine-readable parent and child knowledge objects connected to source evidence, identifiers, and traceable references.

leadership.description: Leads design, simulation, construction, testing, and launch of model rockets using Onshape, OpenRocket, and RocketSim and helped double club membership.
